h: How many years ahead is Ummo?
x: ≈ 4,900 years ahead, from 3,800 to 5,500 years depending on the invention compared. Why the “dark night” changes the lead. The Ummite calendar is counted back from a single landmark: letter D541, written in 1987, says that it is then year 5,923 of the 3rd era D541 p.812. Each era lasts 6,000 Ummo years, roughly 1,270 Earth years D541 p.812. But between the end of the 2nd era and the start of the 3rd, the letter places a period of 11,750 Ummo years, roughly 2,488 Earth years, the “dark night of Ummo” (AGFUIUU DUUA): it “lasted”, but it is “not taken into account” in their numbering of years D541 p.813.Placed on our calendar, it would run from about 1,755 BC to about AD 730. It therefore changes nothing in the dates of the 3rd era, counted directly from 1987. By contrast, everything that precedes it, the 1st and 2nd eras, moves back by about 2,488 years when it is counted. Yet the six inventions compared here all date from the 1st or 2nd era, before the dark night.Current display: dark night counted. This is the reading most faithful to D541, since the period really did last: the Ummite inventions compared then range from about 4,060 to 1,865 BC, and the lead over Earth is about 4,900 years. The Earth dates are conversions made by this site; the letters give only the era and the year. In the letters’ account, each invention of Ummo has a later Earth equivalent. Here is the gap between the two dates. D541 says that the divine figure of Jesus of Galilee would have emerged on Earth around year 2,541 of the 2nd era of Ummo D541 p.812. This landmark only works with the idealised scheme: counting the dark night, year 2,541 of the 2nd era corresponds to about −2,490, whereas Jesus is born in the middle of the dark night, a period that the Ummites do not number. Interpretation proposed by this site, which the letters do not state: lacking an Ummo year for this period, the letter would have counted back from the start of the 3rd era, around 732, without the dark night, which gives year 2,541 of the 2nd era. This would be the origin of the discrepancy between the two readings. UUMMOWOA, the “divine man” of Ummo, is born in year 1,282 of the 2nd era D541 p.812, that is around −2,757 when the dark night is counted. How this estimate is calculated, and its limits For each invention, letter D541 gives the Ummo year in which it appears D541 p.812. I convert it into an Earth year from the letter’s landmark: 4.72 Ummo years equal one Earth year D57-1 p.256 and 1987 corresponds to year 5,923 of the 3rd era D541 p.812. By default, the “dark night”, which lasted 11,750 Ummo years, or about 2,488 Earth years D541 p.813, is counted. The letter’s idealised scheme ignores it and places Jesus around year 2,541 of the 2nd era D541 p.812: the inventions of the first two eras then appear about 2,488 years more recent, and the lead falls to about 2,400 years (button above). The letters give no estimate of this gap: it is a calculation made here. The choice of the Earth equivalent is mine: only photography is a direct match, one other is proposed by the letter itself (printing), and the rest are close or approximate. The estimate assumes that the letters’ account is accurate, without judging it. The letter itself specifies that the synchronisation is idealised D541 p.812: the order of magnitude is therefore more reliable than the figures.

x: This chapter brings together what the documents of the compilation state about the history of the people of Ummo. It reports the file’s account as it is written, without validating or contesting it. Each claim refers to the page of the compilation where it appears: tap a reference to open the text.Three precautions. The file itself points out apocryphal letters attributed to the Ummites D116 p.672 and reports “fraudulently attributed to Ummo” D392 p.755. The typists’ letters are edited as items of non-Ummite origin E26 p.1042. Finally, the letters warn that dates between Ummo and Earth cannot be exactly synchronised D57-1 p.255: the correspondences in this chapter remain approximate.

ch: History of the people of Ummo
x: The Ummites say they come from Ummo, a planet that orbits the star IUMMA, an M-type dwarf star that would be seen from Earth in the constellation of Virgo D21 p.6. Their first letter gives IUMMA an “apparent” distance of 14.437 light-years and a “real” distance of 3.685 light-years, measured in a ten-dimensional space D21 p.5.On Ummo, the day lasts about 30.9 Earth hours, and one Earth year equals 4.72 Ummo years D57-1 p.256. The Ummo year has 60 Ummo days, or about two and a half Earth months D43 p.180.According to letter D541, the rational being, the OEMII, appeared on the old volcanic lands of Ummo about 9.3 million Earth years ago D541 p.811. Around 2.5 million Earth years ago, the ancestors wrote with an almost ideographic alphabet and counted in base ten D541 p.812. Soundings by neutrino beams describe ancestors who dug underground houses in friable volcanic soil and formed very warlike groups D541 p.814. Their writings range from interwoven fibres to hammered copper plates, and great rock stelae bore medical texts open to all D541 p.814. ≈ 9.3 million years agoAppearance of the OEMII on the volcanic lands of UmmoD541 p.811≈ 2.5 million years agoAlmost ideographic writing and decimal numerationD541 p.812

ch: History of the people of Ummo
h: 4 IE 456, Ummowoa and the end of tyranny
x: Letter D43 recounts the “gravest” crisis in the history of Ummo D43 p.180. I4IE 456, daughter of N3NA 312, is elected supreme leader by the council of governors; D41-15 describes her as a precocious scientist, a professor at 13 D41-15 p.154. On the 17th day of her rule, she has nine of her twelve advisers executed and proclaims herself sole mistress D41-15 p.154. She makes scientific research the supreme goal, to the point of being ready to sacrifice men D41-15 p.155, in a climate of terror in which the text cites vivisections on young subjects D41-15 p.155.On her death, her daughter W1WIE 1, aged 12, is imposed as leader: for the first time since year zero, the supreme leader is not elected by the governors D43 p.182. Her term of office is said to have caused at least four million victims D41-15 p.156.It is in this setting that UUmmowoa appears. A forced labourer among thousands of others at the great solar power station of IUMMASNEII D43 p.181, he spreads his teachings in secret, through writings, recordings and telepathic transmission D43 p.184. On night 15 of the year 1402, he gives himself up to the authorities so as not to compromise his followers, then undergoes martyrdom D43 p.184. He leaves about 1,200 aphorisms, the TAAU D43 p.185; D41-15 sees in this the first appearance of a religious cult on Ummo D41-15 p.156, and D43 compares his figure with that of Jesus D43 p.185.An explosive, apparently planted by a servant of W1WIE 1, ends her reign D41-15 p.156. A hatred of science follows: laboratories, sound libraries, universities and the OORGAOWI power station are destroyed by the crowds, and research is held back for many years D41-15 p.156. From this metamorphosis is born, according to the letter, the UMMOAELEWE, which then organises society by directing each person according to their aptitudes and remunerating them according to their output D41-15 p.156 D41-15 p.157. 2nd era, year 1,230Birth of I4IE 456, “the cruel child”D541 p.8122nd era, year 1,283Birth of UUmmowoaD541 p.8122nd era, year 1,402On night 15, UUmmowoa gives himself up to the policeD43 p.1842nd era, year 1,405UUmmowoa “disintegrates”D541 p.812

ch: History of the people of Ummo
h: 5 The 1948 signal and the journey to Earth
x: According to letter D57-1, an automatic station on Ummo tasked with listening to the Galaxy picks up, two Earth years before 28 March 1950, a very faint signal at 413.43877 megacycles per second D57-1 p.256. It lasts 6.83 minutes and alternates short and long pulses. It is Morse code, which the technicians first read as a binary code; their mistaken translation finds in it four orthogonal points on a plane D57-1 p.256, and they imagine a “square planet” D57-1 p.257.The journey cannot be made in a straight line: at 118,000 km/s, the direct trip would take more than thirty-five years D57-1 p.258. The Ummites describe a universe of ten known dimensions D57-1 p.258 and a process that axially inverts the particles of the ship in order to change three-dimensional frame of reference D57-1 p.259 D57-3 p.271. It is possible only when the “folds of space” bring two stars close together D57-1 p.260. After 193 Ummo days, the conditions are favourable: twenty-four men set out in two lenticular ships, exploring Neptune, then Mars, then the Earth without landing D57-1 p.260. Listen

II · Ummo according to the letters › The language›Chapter 25 of 31The language · Chapter 25Ummite writing and words 302 symbols taken from the letters, 581 words with their translation, and how to count, calculate and pronounce: enough to learn to read a few lines of Ummite.

The letters present Ummite writing as small drawings inserted in the text, which this site has retrieved from the compilation. They report that about 2.5 million Earth years ago, the ancestors wrote with a “quasi-ideographic” alphabet D541 p.812. One conversation describes more modest beginnings: branches tied together like beads on a string to keep stories, then very thin copper plates engraved with a wooden stylus. The writing was ideographic and highly stylised, made of geometric figures: a man was an inverted “V” topped by a small circle H21 p.1335. Key pointThe symbols in the compilation are handwritten reproductions of uneven quality. Several letters specify that this is a transcription made by Earthling correspondents.Image quality. We started from poor-quality scanned documents: the symbols are often only a few tens of pixels across. The symbols shown on this site are therefore a digital reconstruction (automatic vectorisation). They may smooth, fill in or distort details of the original: refer to the cited page of the compilation to see the original document.

The Ummites used to count in base ten, but their current numeration is base 12 D541 p.812. An editor’s note gives an example: the number “12” written in base 12 is worth 14 in base 10 D33-1 p.41. The unit of length ENMOO is defined from “12 to the power 6” times a wavelength D37-2 p.71. Here are the Ummite digits from 1 to 12, then zero, after a handwritten chart in the compilation D45 p.195. Beneath each symbol is the corresponding Earth value. The symbols are redrawn from the image of the chart: they may differ from the original. 1234567891011120 Converter: base 10 → base 12 Number in base 10 14 in base 10 is written 12 in base 12.14 = 1 × 12 + 2 ; 1 = 0 × 12 + 1The digits 10 and 11 are written A and B in this converter; the chart gives a symbol for each of the twelve digits, from 1 to 12.

Letter D45 shows how Ummite mathematicians write their operations D45 p.196 D45 p.197. The remarks in green are the editor’s, who worked out the shape of the signs. Tap a symbol to see its context in the letter. Examples of algorithms given in the letter: 31 + 46 + 3 = 80; 2 × 4 × 8 = 64; 12 : 3 = 4; 43 = 64 D45 p.196.
Values given in D21 p.7 D37-2 p.71.

The letters say that the Ummites express themselves in two ways at once: an articulated voice, close to our languages, and a code made of repetitions of words D21 p.6. In D77, this second language is called OIYOYOIDAA: complex ideas are coded in numbers, each base-12 digit being expressed by repeating the same word D75 p.534. The example given is “this greenish planet seems to float in space”, which would be said in everyday language as AYIIO NOOXOEOOYAA DOEE USGIGIIAM D75 p.534. A sentence to read aloud ALABA NA EBOEE O.OUDO OULROA.AIIA French transcription of a text written in right-hand rotation, meaning “It is requested that this text be read aloud in its entirety” D26 p.21.
In D45, after the formulas, the author writes: “you can see that we use the symbol of WOA”, the Ummite name for God, the Generator D45 p.197.

According to NR-20 (2004), the Ummites reason with a “tetravalent” logic: what is not A is not simply the opposite of A. With two opposite states, A (AÏOOYAA, verifiable existence) and B (AÏOOYEEDOO, the unreal), one obtains four cases: A alone, B alone, A and B at once, neither A nor B NR-20 p.1400. The letter illustrates this with colours: yellow for A, red for B; orange mixes the two, blue contains neither NR-20 p.1400. Calculations branch at each “point of uncertainty” (IBOSZOO IOUBOO), and each branch is followed to the end; reasoning by contradiction is avoided NR-20 p.1401. Tap a zoneOrange. A potential or partly undetermined state, like Schrödinger’s cat; NR-20 also applies it to the IAGIAAIAOO nebulae, whose cooling precedes the fold in space that causes it.

GR1-3 (2012) states that most of the drawings and handwriting sent in the past were made by paid Earthling collaborators, and that the others were drawn by Ummites “clumsily copying” their style GR1-3 p.1429. The author attaches an example of writing, produced, he says, in 0.4 UIW, or about one minute GR1-3 p.1431. The same letter says that a former collaborator, whose name it withholds, no longer represents them since his serious brain accident GR1-3 p.1429. In 1987, D393 states that it has taken up the same typewriter as for the first letters in Spanish, a HISPANO OLIVETTI Studio 46, so that they would not be confused with apocryphal letters. II · Ummo according to the letters › Knowledge›Chapter 19 of 31Knowledge · Chapter 19Ummite cosmology, step by step A cosmos made of folds, twin cosmos and IBOZOO UU: the central ideas of the file, explained through animations you can manipulate. Each notion points to the pages of the letters on which it rests.

WAAMthe Universe, seen as a ten-dimensional cosmos. It has a twin, the UWAAM.IBOZOO UUthe elementary building block: not a point, but an orientation linked to others.WOAthe Generator, at the origin of the waves whose folds are masses. This chapter reports what the letters say. It does not endorse these claims: several run counter to accepted notions (for example, the non-existence of the point, the straight line and the plane in the cosmos D59-2 p.315 D59-2 p.325).

The idea in one sentence. What we see, touch or smell is a construction of our brain: behind it there is only a succession of waves and IBOZOO UU. Wavelength of the stimuluscourtelongue How to read the animation. Drag the slider: the wave train (top) changes wavelength. On the right, what the mind makes of it: a colour, then heat. The external reality is the same, the illusion changes.

The vivid colours of a flowerbed are merely a beautiful psychological perception: outside us, there remains “a cold range of electromagnetic frequencies”. D59-2 p.313The same vibratory stimulus is perceived as a patch of colour or as heat depending on its wavelength: “one and the same external reality causes different illusions”. D52 p.240The terrestrial physicist already knows this: when holding a lighter, one does not touch its surface, because large distances separate the atoms of the metal from those of the skin. D59-2 p.314The letter draws a stronger conclusion from this: space itself would be an illusion of our senses, produced by the action of fields on our nerve endings. D52 p.240 The letters’ analogy. A child shut in a room and taught only the letters of a language would believe that objects have the shape of the letters that name them. D59-2 p.315

h: 2 The folds of space: the shortcut to Ummo
x: The idea in one sentence. Space folds in a fourth dimension; when two stars draw closer through a fold, the shortest path is no longer that of light. Curvature of space (fold)faiblepronouncedVariable folds (influence of the twin cosmos) How to read the animation. The red line follows the sheet of space: it is the path of light. The green line is the isochronous line, the true shortest distance. Increase the curvature: the green shortens and, beyond a certain fold, Ummo becomes closer than α Centauri. The folds vary over time, like a sheet shaken by the wind.

The cosmos is a ten-dimensional space-time continuum, curved as a whole, like an inverse hypersphere, and subject to two other types of curvature. D45 p.192Galaxies, stars, the human body, a stone are only small “hollows” of space across a fourth axis. D45 p.193The great folds vary constantly, as wind ripples a spread sheet; they are due to the influence of the UWAAN, the twin cosmos. Earth scientists are unaware of these folds. D45 p.193Apparent distance of α Centauri: about 4.4 light-years. IUMMA (Wolf 424): more than 14 light-years. If space curves, the real distance to Ummo can become shorter than to α Centauri: “this has happened a few times”. D45 p.194A journey is possible only when the folds bring two stars closer. They are aperiodic and predictable only in the short term, with wide margins of error. D57-1 p.260

The letter says that the cosmos is curved “like an inverse hypersphere” D45 p.192. D41-15 specifies that the two twin cosmos have the radius of a “Hypersphere of negative curvature” D41-15 p.158. A hypersphere is the equivalent of a sphere with one more dimension: a three-dimensional space closed back on itself. Nobody can see it directly, since one would have to stand in a fourth dimension. Mathematicians therefore remove one dimension: they draw a two-dimensional surface with the same curvature, and imagine flat beings living on it. ↻ drag to rotateLoading the 3D figure… Negative curvature: the “pseudosphere”. This is the surface that Beltrami gave in 1868 as a model of Lobachevsky’s geometry, which the letter cites. It dips inwards like a saddle everywhere: two travellers who set off in parallel move away from each other, and the angles of a triangle add up to less than 180°. View from the inside. A surface of negative curvature as an inhabitant would measure it (Poincaré disc). All the heptagons are the same size: they seem to shrink towards the edge because an infinite surface is being squeezed into a disc, whose edge is infinitely far away. On a flat surface, the angles of a regular heptagon are 128.6°; here, three heptagons meet at each vertex and each has only 120°. The figures are two-dimensional analogies; they do not claim to show the real shape of space. Reading “inverse” as “of negative curvature” rests on D41-15. The letters’ analogy. A spread sheet that a gust of wind ripples: two distant points on the cloth can end up very close if one crosses the fold instead of following the sheet. Letter D63, addressed to Dionisio DGGarrido, describes nebular conglomerates shaped like a ring or torus with an elliptical, highly turbulent section. The Ummites call them IAGIAAIAOO. D63 p.394 D63 p.395Their composition: hydrogen at a temperature so close to absolute zero that it would be in the solid state, in the form of very small crystals, according to analysis of the light passing through the medium. D63 p.395YOOGOO 75 discovers a weak magnetic field whose lines of force lie in planes perpendicular to the toroidal section. D63 p.395No flow of charged particles is detected, nor any radio signal. Only the sodium D line is polarised (0.8 radian). Within the nebula, very dense lenticular conglomerates emit trains of gravitational waves with a frequency of “/5833 kilocycles per second”. The nearest, IAGIAAIAOO UO, is about 7.884 light-years from Ummo. D63 p.396The plane of the magnetic field suddenly begins to oscillate, with no change in its intensity, aperiodically, then the oscillation dies out. UDII 24 discovers that this occurs a few months after a great curvature of space caused by the twin cosmos, every XEE (about 0.42 year). D63 p.396An automatic probe, programmed in a titanium crystal, measures in IAGIAAIAOO UO a temperature of −270 °C, a little over three kelvins, constant for 0.7 XEE (1 XEE = 76.65 days), then a sudden drop to −273.14 °C, “two tenths above absolute zero” according to the text. D63 p.396 D63 p.397This drop precedes a fold of space favourable to travel, but the interval varies from 0.4 XEE (31 days) to 3.3 XEE (253 days). In 1967, the letter thus expects a favourable phase, with ships bound for Spain, South America and Australia, and a margin of error up to 6 or 7 June 1967. D63 p.397The thermometer is a small tantalum bar (superconducting at 4.4 K) surrounded by a winding creating about 500 oersteds, in a capsule of hydrogen solidified at 3.5 K. Under this field the tantalum is a normal conductor; if the ambient temperature drops below 3 K, it becomes conductive and the heat exchange is recorded. The Ummites say they now use molecular control in a cerium chloride crystal. D63 p.398 The images are artist’s impressions. The number and position of the lenticular conglomerates, the layout of the lines of force, the position of the fold on the curve and the diagram of the thermometer are our own: the letter gives the durations, temperatures and principles. The text gives −273.14 °C and “two tenths” above absolute zero; these two values do not coincide (−273.14 °C is 0.01 K away), and we reproduce them as they stand.

h: 5 Masses are waves: WOA and the folds
x: The idea in one sentence. According to the letter, WOA generates an infinity of wave trains; their standing waves and nodes are what we call masses. Number of wave trains emitted by WOA1146Phase alignment (“death of the Universe”)disorderphase How to read the animation. Each wave train is a sinusoid. Increase their number: their sum draws hollows and bumps, and the most pronounced are the “masses” (bright points). Push the phase alignment: the folds disappear.

Ummo’s mathematicians attach a transcendent importance to the simple sinusoidal function, called the “mathematical generator of the Generator or God” (WOA). D45 p.197WOA generates an infinite series of wave trains of distinct frequencies, amplitudes and phases; space is thus twisted and covered with standing waves and nodes. D45 p.197These standing waves are the folds of the space-time continuum that we call masses (galaxies, gas, animals…). D45 p.197They would explain the apparent contradiction of an electron being both corpuscle and wave: “a naive confusion”. D45 p.197The death of the Universe will consist in a phase alignment of these infinite wave trains. D45 p.197 Schematic animation: it illustrates the letter’s idea (sum of waves, nodes, phase alignment), not a physics calculation.

h: 6 The IBOZOO UU: the element of the cosmos
x: The idea in one sentence. The cosmos would not be made of points in a space, but of a network of IBOZOO UU, of which only the relative orientations matter. Orientation0°360°35°Automatic rotationIOAWOO angle Θ between the two0°180°50°Number of IBOZOO UU in the chain66024 How to read the animation. Three views. 1) One IBOZOO UU: a bundle of orthogonal axes that do not intersect; vary the orientation. 2) Two IBOZOO UU: only the angle between them (IOAWOO) has meaning. 3) A chain: seen from one of its IBOZOO UU, it looks like a straight line, and the traveller who follows it returns to the starting point.

An IBOZOO UU is an elementary entity composed of a bundle of orthogonal axes that cannot intersect, linked to other IBOZOO UU by angular relations. D59-2 p.326It occupies no defined position and does not exist in time: it is itself time. There is no universal reference axis in the cosmos. D59-2 p.319 D59-2 p.320A frame of reference must always be supplied by another IBOZOO UU: one can speak only of the IOAWOO angle between two. An isolated IBOZOO UU is meaningless. D59-2 p.322A “straight line” is only an annular chain (OXOOIAEE) of IBOZOO UU whose orientations differ by an infinitesimal angle; by following it, one returns to the original IBOZOO UU. D59-2 p.323 D59-2 p.324The point, the line and the plane would be mental fictions; an elementary segment is a bound pair of IBOZOO UU. D59-2 p.325“Sub-particles” (neutrino, meson, antiproton…) would be only multiple orientations of one and the same IBOZOO UU. D59-2 p.326An axis, OAWOO, is not a straight line: the word designates a direction, but never an ideal straight line. D59-3 p.331 The letters’ analogy. The cosmos “is like a swarm of dragonflies” whose wings form angles that are all different; no two dragonflies have an identical orientation. D59-2 p.319 The letter warns that its images are “excessively crude”: an IBOZOO UU is neither a point nor a real axis.

Letter D59-4 warns that an IBOZOO UU is not a particle, and that the planetary model of the atom taught to children is an erroneous model that they keep all their lives. D59-4 p.340An OAWOO (axis) is neither a measurable quantity nor a convention: it does not exist without another OAWOO with which it forms an elementary angle, the IOAWOO. This angle is not formed by intersecting lines or planes. D59-4 p.341The IBOZOO UU has no mass, no momentum, no energy, no electric charge: these notions are associated with a particular orientation of such elements. D59-4 p.341 D59-4 p.342The Ummites confirm the masses measured by Earth physicists (proton, electron, mesons…), but dispute the interpretation. For them, spin is not a rotation: the possible orientations of the OAWOO quaternion are measured as a continuous, non-quantised quantity. They also reject the idea of a proton made of mesons. D59-4 p.343The string comparison: a runner carries a Bengal light along a string of firecrackers that explode one after another. From a distance, one thinks one sees two lights side by side. Earth physicists would accept the runner’s version; the Ummites know that the movement of particles is akin to the string. D59-4 p.344A β electron leaving a grain is not the same as the one that strikes an oxygen molecule: “the electron in itself does not exist”. There is a chain of IBOZOO UU, inaccessible to our senses or instruments, some of whose OAWOO orient themselves consecutively, then return to their original orientation: this is the illusion of movement. D59-4 p.344 D59-4 p.345One cannot conceive of an isolated particle outside the WAAM, any more than a wave without water. Energy is quantised, and so is distance: one cannot distinguish a “sensible” quantity smaller than 12-13 centimetres, the angular relation between two connected IBOZOO UU. A subatomic particle is based on one IBOZOO UU and another connected to it. D59-4 p.345In a network (AYUU) of IBOZOO UU none of whose axes is perpendicular to the drawn plane, an observer would see the “void” and identify it with nothing: no matter, no gravitational or electromagnetic field, no weak or nuclear interactions. D59-4 p.345 D59-4 p.346If the IBOZOO UU shown in orange tilts one of its OAWOO, called OAWOOYEY, by an angle α = π/6 radian (image 33), the letter stops there: image 33 is missing and the document breaks off, suggesting that a continuation has been lost. D59-4 p.346 The two images are artist’s impressions. In the animation, the number of firecrackers, the speed, the shape of the crosses (three axes that do not intersect) and the sequence of orientations are our own; the letter gives the principle of the string and the angle α = π/6, with no complete drawing or continuation. We do not show what the tilt produces, since the text does not say.

h: 8 Changing frame: when mass becomes energy

h: 12 The birth of a cosmos and the role of WOA
x: The idea in one sentence. In the beginning, a nucleus of matter and antimatter explodes; without the intervention of WOA, the uniform expansion would collapse at once. How to read the animation. Compare the two cases. Without WOA: the isotropic “cosmic crystal” expands, then collapses. With WOA: an asymmetry breaks the uniformity, clusters form, and their matter-antimatter collisions release the energy that sustains the expansion.

In the “beginning” there was the WAAM, coexisting with WOA; it contained all its mass in an infinite initial nucleus of matter and antimatter: an unstable “cosmion” that exploded. D731 p.830The expansion is like a bubble swelling, a hyperspherical membrane whose radius increases. Without WOA, the expansion would have been offset by the gravity of an infinite mass. D731 p.830WOA introduced an asymmetry induced “intelligently”: Creation. Masses of opposite signs collide and the resulting energy counteracts the gravitational collapse. D731 p.830The letters also describe cosmos born with an infinite radius and an isotropic distribution of mass (the cosmic crystal), later disturbed by adjacent cosmos. D731 p.817 Schematic animation: it illustrates the letters’ account, with no real scale or dynamics.

The idea in one sentence. When a ship inverts its subparticles, celestial bodies cease to be perceived as masses and vast clouds of subparticles appear in their place. Artist’s impression. It is inspired by D59-1 D59-1 p.311; the letters do not describe the spectacle more precisely.

Planets and hot celestial bodies are no longer concentrations of mass for the travellers, and “they may disappear for our sense organs”. D59-1 p.311 Factors that appeared as concentrations of light energy present themselves, once inverted, as “immense clouds of atomic subparticles”; a collision with these nebulae would be fatal to the ship. D59-1 p.311 The perceptions are not “truly extraordinary”: no colours never seen before, no hallucinatory sounds; the sense organs encode as usual. D59-1 p.311 According to the sheet analogy, a hollow seen from one face is a proton and, seen from the back, a protuberance, the antiproton; what is perceived as heat may correspond to a different frequency. The later letters say that inverting all the angles is equivalent to projecting oneself into OUWAAM NR-22 p.1414. The letter announces a forthcoming report that would describe the travellers’ “panorama” D59-1 p.311; I have not found it in the compilation. h: 1 The code of life and the BAAYIODUU
x: The idea in one sentence. The letters describe DNA as terrestrial biology does, then add a factor unknown to our laboratories: 86 pairs of krypton atoms at the end of the chromosome, which would contain all possible forms of life and could trigger mutations. The IXOUURAA (DNA) has the shape of a double helix. Its components are phosphoric acid (IOGAARAA), the sugar deoxyribose (UUDUAGOO) and four bases: adenine (IXOIAROO), thymine (IUAGAROO), cytosine (IDUIROO) and guanine (IVOOROO), the IGOOMII, symbolic factors of the code. D58-2 p.289 D58-2 p.290The process is described as “almost known” to Earthlings: the chromosome sequence is copied into RNA, which passes from the nucleus to the protoplasm; the amino acids (21 known to them) position themselves on this mould, each coded by a key of three signs. D58-2 p.291 D58-2 p.292An IDUGOO (mutation) may come from external radiation, but “many mutations are caused within the individual itself by a mechanism unknown to you”. The letters raise the question of orthogenesis: why do mutations almost always move in the direction of improvement? D58-2 p.293 D58-2 p.294The BAAYIODUU is a series of 86 sets of two krypton atoms, at the ends of the DNA chain. The pairs rotate on common orbits around an axis that vibrates; frequency and amplitude depend on temperature (0.2 megacycle at 35 °C). The discovery is attributed to INNAI 3, then the function to AOYOO 221. D58-2 p.294The homologous atoms in the spermatozoa of 134 vertebrate species rotate in synchrony. The phenomenon would be cosmological: it was also verified in 1951 on terrestrial human cells. The first idea, identifying this krypton with the OEMBUAW (the third factor of man), was set aside. D58-2 p.295The BAAYIODUU has two missions: to store the coded information of all possible organic beings, and to pick up that of the environment so as, in certain cases, to bring about a mutation towards a being already drawn in the code. In each pair, a fixed atom codes the stereotyped message (one page of a dictionary of 43 leaves); the other, dynamic, picks up the cytoplasm and, through its quantum alterations, causes mutations in the DNA. D58-3 p.297 D58-4 p.304Each jump of an electron in one of the eight subshells of krypton codes a phylum. A node of the tree (IBOZOODAO) has from 50,000 to 18 million possible mutations; only a few of them are realised on a given planet. The number of possible human subspecies is 9·10⁶. It would memorise mainly the 21.106 cm wave of neutral hydrogen, through its variations over a threshold period of 877.533 terrestrial years, the water of the cytoplasm serving as receiver. D58-1 announces a report on the biogenetic bases of living beings and on the way the “neuroencephalisation” of man takes place progressively. D58-1 p.285The most important property of a network is EIDOAYUEE (emergence): it has properties that its elements do not have. Five points and five separate segments have nothing “pentagonal” about them; joined together, they generate a new property. No component of a radio transmitter radiates on its own. D792-1 p.865A jump in complexity (information density) is a necessary but not sufficient condition. D792-1 p.865 D792-1 p.866Coelenterates: sensitive cells (protoneurons); elementary emergence, receiving information and reacting by reflex. D792-1 p.866 D792-1 p.867Fish, amphibians, reptiles and mammals form an encephalic mass capable of deterministic decisions, without free will, according to “programmings of stored data”, with learning and conditioned reflexes. (IDUUGOO), about 218,000 possible structural mutations per phylum, whose instructions are decoded by a krypton network; or biotechnology (BAAYIIBUUTD), with serious ethical implications. The letter judges this event impossible in practice for a man. D792-1 p.869 D792-1 p.870Last leap, the OIXIOOWOA: a mutation produces a brain of entirely new emergence (the OEMMIIWOA). Its probability is close to one in the first ten million years of a humanity. h: 3 The soul, krypton and the collective soul
x: The idea in one sentence. A network of krypton atoms links each living being to another universe where information is stored and processed; the collective soul sends back patterns of form in return. Show the OEMII (rational being)Show the patterns sent back (orthogenesis) How to read the animation. Each being (bacterium, fish, gazelle) sends data through its krypton cloud to the planet’s collective soul. The OEMII, the rational being, has a second cloud, the OEMBUUAUW, which transmits far more: ideas, symbols, feelings. In return, the collective soul guides evolution (orthogenesis).

A microphysical network of krypton atoms acts as a valve that connects the organism to another universe, where information is coded: the collective psyche, what we call the “collective unconscious”. D731 p.822Eighty-six krypton atoms would suffice to code all the viable forms of living beings. D731 p.822Each cell of this universe, called B.B. (“spirit or collective soul”), corresponds to the set of living beings of a cold star: it is rather an “extracosmic encephalon”. D731 p.828 D731 p.829A fish sends information about its genes and its environment and receives only patterns of form; the OEMII, thanks to the OEMBUUAUW, also transmits what it symbolises, thinks and feels. D731 p.829In return, each B.B. sends its biological patterns to living beings to guide their evolution (orthogenesis), and its universal ideas to the OEMII; the letter sees in this the origin of extrasensory communication and of moral laws “written” in advance. D731 p.831A living organism is defined as a network of IBOZOO UU capable of reproducing itself and of enriching its internal information at the expense of external information. D731 p.820

x: The idea in one sentence. According to the letters, everything that a living being perceives, and for man everything that he thinks and feels, is copied by krypton atoms to another universe, the WAAM of the collective psyche, which responds with patterns of form and behaviour. When one sees, smells or touches an object such as a poppy, the information passes from the neurosensors to the brain, which processes and stores it while transferring it to a chain of krypton atoms. Their peripheral electrons “transmit” it to another universe, that of the collective psyche, and to that of the individual soul. h: 5 An Ummite life: education, couple, chosen death
x: The idea in one sentence. The letters describe a very regulated life: instruction from childhood, university at 13.68 years, a partner chosen at about 15.5 years, then a voluntary death between 91 and 121 years. A timeline lets you walk through it. Age (Earth years)014010 yearsPlay through a life How to read the animation. Sexual information has “never been taboo”: when children reach mental maturity (and not a fixed age), their parents inform them through suitable images, which the SANMOO AYUBAA network supplies to them. The educational images are of a calibrated sobriety and differ from one child to another. D41-11 p.140 D41-13 p.145From 13.68 years, boys and girls are educated in the UNAWO UE, “small towns in miniature” with rigid discipline. Coeducation concerns only small groups; for a few hours a day, games between young people of both sexes are permitted, stimulated and regulated. D41-13 p.146At about 15.5 years, the young man chooses his partner and submits his choice to the teaching authorities, who check through the network for any incompatibility. If the young woman accepts, the two wait for her first menstruation to begin their relations; in the meantime, they communicate neither orally nor by telepathy. Premarital relations are limited to touch, without direct access to the erogenous zones, for a period set by the authorities. D41-13 p.146 D41-13 p.147According to the letter, the interval between puberty and marriage must be minimal, and the Earth is the only planet known to the authors where it is tolerated for it to be long. They say they know neither prostitution nor endemic sexual perversions. D41-13 p.147Marriage is a ritual, religious and legal ceremony, in the presence of twelve people (a number said to be conventional); the couple then withdraws to an isolated room. The parents are informed but do not intervene in the choice. D41-13 p.147In the home, the husband’s authority “is never discussed” and the wife is subordinate to him, without losing her right to an opinion or her dignity. Before the government and society, her rights are the same as those of the man, and her place depends on her ability. At the time of the letter, the Council of Ummo had four men; the sub-council had 28 women out of 116 members. The men, they say, accept being commanded by a woman less readily than Earthlings do. D41-13 p.148 D41-13 p.149The woman covers her thorax all her life; the thighs, arms, head, throat, hands and feet are not erogenous zones. Forced nudity is experienced as a humiliation, to the point of being one of the penalties of the legal code. Lips and the kiss “have no meaning” for them. D41-13 p.145 D41-13 p.146Medicine compensates for the degenerations of age (no bone or cardiovascular problems or cancers as on Earth), but the authors deliberately keep a cerebral degeneration. Barring accident, death is a voluntary act between 432 and 575 XEE (91 to 121 terrestrial years), although one could exceed 140 years. NR-18 p.1393The ceremony of conversion into helium, generally decided on by the two partners, gathers the family up to the fifth generation: frugal meal, farewells, a film of the life. A blue flash marks the emission of a gravitational field that instantly destroys the brain cells; the body is converted into helium. NR-18 p.1393 NR-18 p.1394 Schematic drawing. The ages on the timeline (13.68; 15.5; 91 to 121; 140) come from the letters; the age of marriage and of setting up a home is not given, the timeline states it. The letters are reported without judging them.

h: 6 The couple’s children and the population
x: The idea in one sentence. Each couple has a first child, then may ask for a second, which is discouraged for the third and forbidden for the fourth. Each couple has the right and the duty to have a first child, at a date of its choosing. The second requires a reasoned request to the birth-planning group, generally accepted when the first has reached learning autonomy (between 7.6 and 8.5 years). A third is discouraged, possibly accepted if the first two are girls, or proposed by the educational centre when they show exceptional aptitudes. A fourth is no longer permitted. NR-18 p.1393Ovulation is tracked exactly by the couple’s domestic systems, which avoids almost all hormonal contraception. The minimum period of fertility is 46 UIW. D41-12 p.144 NR-18 p.1393Population: about 2.58 billion targeted at the start of the “4th age”, with a birth rate fixed at 60/1728 every 12 XEE, or 13.7‰ per terrestrial year. Mortality equals 13.7‰: demographic stability is the rule. NR-18 p.1391 NR-18 p.1393 Schematic drawings. The ages 7.6 to 8.5 years, the cases of the third child, the rate of 13.7‰ and the 2.58 billion come from the letter NR-18. The population curve is a simple exponential projection of our own: it assumes the 2.58 billion and mortality remain constant.

h: 2 The sky of Ummo: NAWEE and the calendar
x: The idea in one sentence. A gas giant, NAWEE, passes behind the star every 2.571 XEE; it is on its passages that the ancient astronomers built the XEE, slipping the constant π into it.

NAWEE is a “gas giant” that orbits IUMMA (IOUMMA) closer than Ummo. It is clearly visible at the rising and setting of the star. Its extremely hot atmosphere is stirred by violent storms whose scintillations give it a luminosity of its own. NR-21 p.1408D45 (1966) already named this body, in the form NAUEE: the cosmic unit of length GOSEEE equals the distance from IUMMA to NAUEE at its apogee. D45 p.198Characteristics given by NR-21: equatorial radius 6.22·10⁷ m, mass 9.91·10²⁵ kg, mean distance to IUMMA 5.97·10¹⁰ m (Ummo: 9.96·10¹⁰ m), eccentricity 0.026, inclination of the orbit to that of Ummo 1.53°. NR-21 p.1407 NR-21 p.1409The ancient astronomers observed the superior conjunctions of NAWEE, when it passes behind IUMMA: on average every 2.571 XEE. In six revolutions of Ummo, seven are counted; the complete cycle, the XEEOUMMO, lasts eighteen XEE, during which NAWEE makes thirteen turns. NR-21 p.1407 NR-21 p.1409At each conjunction, NAWEE seemed to rise or descend relative to the disc of IUMMA. Unaware that the two orbits are not in the same plane, the cosmologists concluded that the trajectory of Ummo was “bi-helical”: three descents and three ascents on a cylinder per XEEOUMMO. NR-21 p.1407The complete cycle equals 1,079.979 rotations of Ummo (1,391.22 Earth days); the XEE is its eighteenth part. It was fixed at exactly 60 ancient XI, or 36,000 OUIW or 77.303 Earth days. The revolution of Ummo, about 229.5 days, is slightly less than three XEE. NR-21 p.1409 NR-21 p.1408The cosmologists worshipped the number π and wanted the XEE to equal the fraction 2/(2+π) of the synodic period of NAWEE, accepting a drift of six OUIW (18.55 minutes) per XEE: one day every 100 XEE, one XEE every 6,000 XEE. NR-21 p.1407 NR-21 p.1408The followers of the NAWEE cult, outraged, announced the end of the humanity of Ummo when the drift reached one XEE, after 6,000 XEE. The monarch of the time rejected the imprecation and had the priests stripped and publicly flogged; the cult gradually disappeared. The error still persists: projects to modify the orbit of Ummo and cancel it were refused. NR-21 p.1407 NR-21 p.1408 NR-21 p.1409The official day (XI) comprises 600 OUIW, but the actual rotation lasts 600.0117 OUIW; one OUIW equals 185.527 seconds. An attempt was made to add one OUIW every 84 XI, except once every 84 XEE, then it was abandoned: the climate of Ummo depends on latitude, not on position in the orbit, and sowing does not require a precise calendar. NR-21 p.1408 NR-21 p.1409There is no Ummite word for “year” in the astronomical sense; the revolution of Ummo is called SAAXEE. The letter compares the creation of the calendar, in year 0 of the first era, with the European Renaissance and the Gregorian calendar. NR-21 p.1408 NR-21 p.1409Our own check: 2/(2+π) × 2.571 XEE ≈ 1.000 XEE, so the figures of NR-21 are consistent with one another. Two points remain curious: NR-21 says NAWEE is “about half as large” as Saturn, but the radius given (62,200 km) exceeds that of Saturn (about 58,200 km, Earth value); and the letter first says that the monarch “ruled in favour of the majority”, then, in the appendix, that he had the priests flogged. NR-21 was received in March 2009; the only earlier mention of the body is that of D45, in 1966.

h: 4 Population, births and end of life
x: The idea in one sentence. Ummo aims at a stable population of 2.58 billion inhabitants, with authorised births and a chosen death.

The ideal target population is 2.58 billion inhabitants, for a mean density of about 10 inhabitants per km²; in the inhabited colonies, it ranges from 68 to 136 inhabitants per km². NR-18 p.1391Births and deaths balance each other: the mortality rate and the birth rate are both about 13.7 per thousand per year. NR-18 p.1391 NR-18 p.1393NR-22 specifies that Ummite demography counts foetuses in utero: the rate of 13.7‰ includes very high foetal mortality. Each XEE, 7.465 million conceptions are authorised and 4.987 million infants are born, an in-utero mortality of 33.2%; 4.943 million survive beyond 10 XEE. NR-22 p.1412Conception is confirmed by the household computer after implantation of the egg, after 4,000 OUIW (6.7 Ummo days). The foetal stage is reached 0.6 XEE after conception; the sex is then revealed to the parents and the child is registered by name. Pregnancy lasts 3.6 XEE; delivery is induced on the 216th day if it has not occurred, and the baby generally weighs more than 4 kg. NR-22 p.1412Mortality after birth comes almost entirely from early craniosynostosis: the bones of the skull fuse too early and compress the brain. It mainly affects young males (79.1% of cases) during the first ten XEE. Thanks to “orthocranial” measures, each twelve-XEE age bracket comprises about 59.32 million young people, against 59.84 million without this cause. NR-22 p.1412Procreation is forbidden outside the OMGEEYIE, the marital couple. The right and duty to procreate a first child is unfailing; a second child requires authorisation from the planning group IWOONA OUIWAAGOO. NR-18 p.1392 NR-18 p.1393A third child is discouraged, and accepted if the first two are girls; a fourth is no longer authorised. NR-18 p.1393Hormonal contraception is rare: each woman’s ovulation cycle is known thanks to the household monitoring systems integrated into the XANMOO. NR-18 p.1393 D41-12 p.144Barring accident, death is a voluntary act between 432 and 575 XEE, or from 91 to 121 Earth years; without this, longevity could exceed 140 years. NR-18 p.1393The ceremony of conversion of the OEMII into helium gathers the family; a high-frequency gravitational field causes instant death, then the atoms are converted into helium, mixed with a perfume chosen by the couple. NR-18 p.1393 NR-18 p.1394Our own check: 12 × 4.943 million ≈ 59.3 million, which matches the figure of 59.32 million per twelve-XEE bracket; and 216 Ummo days do make 3.6 XEE, or about 278 Earth days as NR-22 writes.

h: 5 The State, the laws and the council
x: The idea in one sentence. The AYUYISAA, the State of Ummo, rests on three bodies: all citizens make the laws, a council of 116 members judges, and four people lead. All citizens

All OEMII in full possession of their faculties: they create the laws. Each group of 12 chooses a representative (AOUIAOEMII); 1,728 of these elect by secret ballot an OUIAOEMII, who proposes and votes on laws at the UAAYUBAA. D68-1 p.425

Touch a node. Each OEMII is a node linked to the others by arcs: language, economy, contact. A disturbance at one point spreads step by step through the whole network. Our own diagram, after D47: society is “a veritable network” whose individuals are nodes linked by multiple arcs D47-1 p.201; Earthly man is a node whose connections “function in a disastrous manner” D47-2 p.210; in a receiver, cutting a single wire is enough to render the whole network inoperative D47-2 p.211.

The AYUYISAA comprises the UMMOOEMII (all the OEMII in full possession of their faculties), the UMMOAELEWEEANNI (at most 116 members) and the UMMOAELEWEE (four members, the four “supreme leaders”). D68-1 p.425 D68-1 p.427 D68-1 p.426Each group of 12 inhabitants chooses a representative (AOUIAOEMII); 1,728 of these elect by secret ballot an OUIAOEMII, who proposes and votes laws (UAA) in the UAAYUBAA. D68-1 p.425The UAAYUBAA resembles a research laboratory, linked to the computer network XANMOO AYUBAA: the OUIAOEMII are researchers, and the final decisions are taken by specialists. D68-1 p.425 D68-1 p.426No one may be ignorant of the law: the computer network informs everyone of their rights, and the four leaders are subject to it like everyone else. D68-1 p.426Children destined for the council are chosen, without distinction of sex, for a special teaching centre; four are retained for the UMMOAELEWEE and the other 116 form the UMMOAELEWEEANNI, which judges and watches over the balance of powers. D68-1 p.427These elected members must remain humble: they are forbidden to humiliate others for the pleasure of being obeyed, and they accept the most thankless tasks. D68-1 p.427NR-14 (2003) accepts the comparison with Japan, made by an Australian correspondent following Ruth Benedict: Ummo is a “culture of shame”. Anyone who breaks the OUAA (moral laws) is exposed naked in public, and everyone is encouraged to look; a very strong reflex of modesty, instilled from childhood, makes this penalty dreaded. NR-14 p.1379 NR-14 p.1380The same letter mentions “deplorable” periods: the despotic reigns of I4IEE 456 and then W1WIE 1, followed by a long reform of the social network, of which the Ummites say they are “deeply ashamed”. NR-14 p.1379In 1966, none of the four members of the UMMOAELEWEE was a woman, but 28 of the 116 members of the sub-council were. D41-13 p.149D68-2 (1967) details the general council: four members at most, never just one; a term of office of 6.41 Earth years at most, with no re-election and no privilege afterwards; an age between 15.8 and 34.7 years, because psychobiologists place the best intellectual and physical performance at around 26.5 years. Adults nevertheless feel “humiliated” at being led by brothers so young. D68-2 p.431The youngest leader, UIWAA 4, was under 18; his father worked as a labourer, one of the humblest jobs. When the father came to an audience, those who were waiting let him through, and UIWAA 4, moved, touched their knees as a sign of gratitude. The ordinary greeting consists of placing one’s hands on the other person’s chest. D68-2 p.432According to the law, it is the superior who must humbly serve his brothers; he listens, consults the computer network and the specialists, and then decides. If a member of the council gained ascendancy over the others, the 116 of the UMMOAELEWEEANNI would immediately renew the council. D68-2 p.432 D68-2 p.433 D68-2 p.434The letter accepts the word “technocratic” for the methods, but rejects it in the Earthly sense: entrusting power to technicians would only be possible after a high level of social morality had been reached. It also acknowledges that men still feel “an indefinable humiliation” at being led by a woman, despite equality in law. D68-2 p.433 D68-2 p.434The letter summarises the rights guaranteed by the UAA: freedom of belief, assembly and strike, and the right to work, housing, education and medical assistance. It compares this catalogue with the UN’s human rights. D68-1 p.428 D68-1 p.429The Ummites use two logics: a divalent one like ours and a tetravalent one, which makes certain legal notions difficult to translate. D68-1 p.424
The idea in one sentence. No private ownership of capital goods, no money like ours, a working day of less than four hours.

A distinction is made between consumer goods (OUMDAA DOAA: food, clothing, objects, energy) and capital goods (OUMWI AA: machines, vehicles, buildings); the Ummites own no capital goods as private property. D41-16 p.177The synthetic production of carbohydrates, proteins and lipids is so abundant that there is no problem of production or distribution. D41-16 p.177Money does not exist as it does on Earth: each person accumulates a remuneration, depending on their abilities and output, kept in the XANMOO AYUBAA central. D41-13 p.148120 giant XANMOO AYUBAA, linked to a great titanium memory, regulate the activity of the planet. D41-16 p.178The working day is very short: between 50 and 75 UIW, that is 2.6 to 3.9 hours; it is shorter still for demanding occupations. D41-3 p.92The letter describes this civilisation as a socialist structure, deeply religious, founded on a religion with a scientific basis; only the arts, and above all music, would be poorer there than on Earth. D41-16 p.179
The idea in one sentence. Couples live in tower-houses; children are educated separately, away from their parents, until the end of their studies.

A young OMGEEYIE lives in his XAABI, a tower-pavilion in the middle of the countryside. D41-2 p.85As long as the young person has not completed training at the UNAWO WI, he is forbidden to see or hear his parents, except on rare occasions; parents can see their children on the large hemispherical screen of the UULODAXAABI. D41-2 p.85Betrothal includes a purely tactile pre-nuptial phase, the length of which is set by the teaching authorities with the help of the computers; the interval between puberty and marriage must remain minimal. D41-13 p.147After the marriage, the couple choose their home by consulting the computer network, which indicates the balance available to them. D41-13 p.148In the home, the wife submits to her husband’s authority without losing her right to an opinion; before the State, she has the same rights as the man. D41-13 p.149A typical day begins with a family meeting where the father gives instructions after consulting everyone, then with a perfumed steam bath in which blends of essences follow one another “like a symphony”. D41-3 p.94 D41-3 p.95The kiss has no meaning for the Ummites; certain parts of the body are never uncovered in front of other people. D41-13 p.146According to D102, two adolescents who wish to unite consult the computer network, which assesses their compatibility; the opinion is only advisory, and the letter cites a rate of 0.0084 for 144 cases where the couple go ahead regardless. They then remain without communicating until the girl’s first ovulation, at around 15.5 Earth years, celebrated with a feast. D102 p.609 D102 p.610The marriage is concluded before a “minister” representing the UMMOAELEWEE, at once priest, notary and justice of the peace, who records the union in the network. The gesture that seals the agreement is the Ummite greeting: each places their hands on the other’s chest. The parents take no part in the choice. D102 p.611 D102 p.612D540 (1987), addressed “to all the women of Earth”, describes Ummo as a world where equality of rights and abilities applies symmetrically to both sexes, and at length denounces the condition of women on Earth. D540 p.805 D540 p.806 D540 p.809The letters do not all say the same thing: D41 (1966) writes that the wife submits to her husband’s authority in the home, D540 (1987) speaks of a symmetrical equality, and D68-2 admits that men still feel humiliated at being led by a woman.
The idea in one sentence. Each child learns according to their aptitudes, in an audiovisual room at home, then in a university that lasts from two to six years.

Training at the UNAWO WI lasts from 9.46 XEE (about two years) to 28 XEE (a little under six years), depending on each person’s psychotechnical evaluation. D41-6 p.109A child does daily exercises in the audiovisual room of the house; he reaches learning autonomy between 7.6 and 8.5 Earth years, which conditions the birth of a second child. NR-18 p.1393In their schools, children learn two subjects at once, thanks to bi-language: a single teacher delivers two lectures in a single utterance. D41-1 p.82According to D47-2 (1966), every method of education aims to form a network of conditioned reflexes: it is enough for one key reflex to be missing for the whole to collapse. A student who skips a single morning of work at the start of his programme loses more than if he missed the last week. D47-2 p.211 D47-2 p.212Letter D47-4 recounts the failure of the attempt to modify the structure of brains: the scientists gave it up and staked everything on educating natural abilities. D47-4 p.221 D47-4 p.222At 14–16 years, the vocal cords become sclerosed: the person falls silent and develops communication by “PSI”, telepathic, in impulses of 0.00014 second. D41-1 p.82For the first months, the infant lives in a conditioned room: he sees only patches of colour that undulate slowly, all in the same plane, then increasingly complex images, sounds and smells on a domed screen (UULODAXAABI), set according to his psychotechnical record. D41-7 p.122According to D41-7, play (OXUO KEAIA) is “the art of training the body and the mental faculties simultaneously”. It serves to prevent mental disorders, whereas Earth uses it mainly to treat them (play therapy). D41-7 p.117 D41-7 p.118In the past, 30 UIW a day of a physical and mental game in the open countryside, in three teams, partly underwater, were recommended; nearly 70% of the population adopted it. When computers became able to assess the state of each organism in an instant, the present OXUO KEAIA was born: a single game for the whole planet, but with rules specific to each player and changing from one moment to the next. D47-1 p.206 D41-7 p.126According to D102 (1972), young people leave their parents at around 13.7 Earth years for the UNAUO UEEE, without luggage, with only their tunic. The right to training is inalienable: no one can renounce it, not even the person concerned. D102 p.605There they form a small autonomous social network, at first in mixed groups for about 3.2 years, guided by a trio of tutors of both sexes. The pupils rediscover the laws of nature through experience; if a child maintains that the planet is a cylinder, no one laughs and he is helped to check it for himself. D102 p.606 D102 p.608 D102 p.609The letter advises Earth against copying this model, too closely tied to Ummite psychology; for Earth, it considers mixing the sexes “of vital importance” at every level. D102 p.606

The idea in one sentence. A retractable tower-house, rooms with no fixed function, vehicles that fly half a metre above the ground. Time of day0600196196 UIW : Waking; outside, about 3 °C and IUMMA appears between indigo and reddish. D41-3 p.93

The XAABI, mushroom-shaped, emerges at night from its pit on a sodium-vapour piston; it contains about six IAXAABI, rooms that can become a bedroom, kitchen or games room. D41-2 p.86 D41-2 p.88The floor is covered with coloured plates that are in fact hatches from which furniture and equipment emerge; an orange rectangle is the symbol of the seat, which opens on an ultrasonic signal. D41-2 p.89Before sleep, the couple devote 24 UIW to meditation and prayer. D41-2 p.89On waking, at around 196 UIW, the outside temperature is about 3 °C and IUMMA appears in a glow between indigo and reddish. D41-3 p.93Roads have disappeared so as not to spoil the landscapes; the transport of materials takes place underground, by nozzles and aerosols, and plasma currents there reach 2 million degrees. D41-6 p.112GOONIIOADOO UEWA vehicles travel 0.56 m above the ground, piloted by the computer network; the probability of an accident is said to be 0.00007. OEMMIIUEWA personal equipment makes it possible to fly up to 56 m. D41-6 p.110 D41-6 p.111The landscapes are laid out: new forests, artificial rivers, plants with large flowers created in the laboratory; the typical trees are the NAANAA, the IGUU and the OAXAUXAA. D41-6 p.112 D41-6 p.113Flora and fauna are less varied than on Earth, but the vegetation is exuberant, watered by an underground hydro-canalisation network. D41-2 p.86Among the animals mentioned: the GIIDII, a mammal of the depths of the polar seas that vaguely recalls the dolphin, whose milk is used for seasoning; the OERUU IIOSSAUUIGAA, a vertebrate that blends in with the rocks covered in yellowish lichens of the volcanic region of UUIDDAO UYOAA IIO. D41-5 p.107 D58-4 p.305A toxic lichen, the UUXAO, yields a fatty essence whose alkaloid has hallucinogenic effects. D43 p.188Anthropoids, the IEGOOSSAA, live in the upper part of the WOAROO colony, in a nature reserve: bipedal, with thick white or golden body hair, organised in highly hierarchical groups. The Ummites exchange food with them for small coloured pebbles, which are used in their landscape art. NR-21 p.1405 NR-21 p.1406A line selected at the start of the third age, the AAGA IEGOOSSAA (“domesticated”), lives as families in fitted-out caves near the universities; the Ummites hope one day to activate the link to the soul in them. Crossbreeding attempts with the OEMII have produced only non-viable hybrids. NR-21 p.1406

The mushroom house at duskThe houses, called XAABI, are shaped like mushrooms: a tower (ANAUANAA) carries an inhabited dome (XAABIUANNAA) D41-2 p.86. A piston driven by sodium vapour raises them, “almost always at nightfall”, or lowers them to ground level D41-2 p.88. They rotate on themselves, and the night-time countryside “seems filled with coastal lighthouses” D41-2 p.86. The old paths and roads have disappeared D41-2 p.86.Original drawing: letter D41-2, image 1, page 87 of the compilation The interior, in cross-sectionEach house has five or six rooms, with no fixed function D41-2 p.88. The floor bears coloured shapes that are hatches from which the furniture emerges; the orange rectangle corresponds to the seat, with no cushion or back D41-2 p.89. The beds are levitating rings on which a foam solidifies into a divan D41-2 p.89 D41-9 p.132. The roof is made of panels of a germanium compound that is “totally transparent”, removed every other night to sleep under the open sky D41-3 p.92; one then sees the green and purple auroras, the UULIBOOA D41-3 p.93.Original drawing: letter D41-2, images 4, 5 and 7, page 90 of the compilation The first meal of the dayThe first meal, the most substantial, takes place at dawn, when IUMMA rises “between the great indigo and orange mists” D41-5 p.100. Each person has their seat rise from the floor around a rectangular area, which a fine yellowish film, sprayed on, turns into a tablecloth D41-5 p.101. The broths are sucked up through the long tubes of the IOAOOI, “like hookahs”, with no spoon D41-5 p.102 D41-5 p.104. People hardly speak and smile at one another D41-5 p.104. Before solid food, hands are passed through the NAAXUNII D41-5 p.104; there is no knife, but a “cutter”, the EIWOO OINNA, which slices with a fine ultraviolet beam D41-5 p.105.Original drawing: letter D41-5, images 10 and 11, page 101 of the compilation Bedtime: the levitating bedsA brief inaudible whistle brings out the WOOIA: torus-shaped rings, pierced with small holes, which rise “with no support coming from the floor” and remain levitating thanks to an electromagnetic field D41-9 p.132. A foam close to polyurethane flows from them and solidifies into a block, with a central hollow for placing the body D41-9 p.132 D41-9 p.133. In the evening, the couple meditate in a faint cyan light before sleeping D41-2 p.89; people sleep without sheet or blanket D41-9 p.133.Original drawing: letter D41-9, image 19, page 132 of the compilation Artists’ impressions, after the original drawings in the letters and the descriptions cited: they do not come from the compilation. The idea in one sentence. Music of crystalline percussion, an unrivalled art of perfume, buildings all in curves and often underground, and museums devoted to Earth.

Ummite music rests on crystalline sonorities and xylophonic percussion, not on a melodic sequence of frequencies: it increases serenity. The authors judge Earth’s music to be without equivalent among the civilisations they have met. NR-21 p.1403The art of perfume is as masterfully developed on Ummo as music is on Earth: it is the only art in which the Ummites say they stand out from other civilisations. The morning steam bath is composed of essences “like a symphony”. NR-21 p.1404 D41-3 p.95Architecture banishes angular forms in favour of “the harmony of curves”. Administrative, religious or cultural buildings are often buried in the ground: all that can be seen is a glazed structure reflecting the sky, surrounded by fragrant bushes and flowers. NR-21 p.1403The art of landscape is practised by the whole population from childhood; the coloured pebbles obtained from the IEGOOSSAA are used to compose frescoes, paths or to decorate the beds of garden streams. NR-21 p.1403 NR-21 p.1404 NR-21 p.1406Painting and sculpture are judged more accomplished on Earth. The ancestors of the Ummites lived in caves and left a rock art comparable to that of Lascaux or Altamira, but more elaborate. NR-21 p.1403 NR-21 p.1404Museums are dedicated to Earth (OYAGAA); in the colony of OUDIOWEE, an entire building is devoted to Earth culture. NR-21 p.1404 NR-15 p.1382The OUDEXIENOO were ancient monoliths of soft rock, set up in the fields, on which the ancestors engraved recipes and therapeutic advice; a few have been preserved. A tweet from OOMO TOA specifies that they were made of gabbro, engraved with copper tools. D79 p.542 W3 p.1657GR1-3 (2012) says the opposite on one point: the Ummites supposedly never cultivated art (drawing, painting, sculpture, artistic architecture) nor knew how to compose music, which they nevertheless appreciate. Thanks to telepathy, images were transmitted without drawing. GR1-3 p.1428 GR1-3 p.1429NR-21 (2009) describes an Ummite music, painting and architecture; GR1-3 (2012) asserts that they practise no art. We reproduce both versions without deciding between them.ListenDecay to Silence0:002:14Crystal Decay0:001:06Artist’s impression (imagined music) — after NR-21: crystalline sounds and xylophone-like percussion, with no melodic sequence, a music that increases serenity NR-21 p.1403. GR1-3 claims, on the contrary, that the Ummites never cultivated art GR1-3 p.1428.
The idea in one sentence. A religious society with a scientific basis, which believes in WOA, in the soul and in a telepathic link between stellar systems.

The society is deeply religious: it believes in a Creator (WOA), in a factor that we would call the soul, and in a third factor that binds it to the body: krypton atoms in the brain. D84 p.563The telepathic link is said to be the only one allowing simultaneous contact between two stellar systems; distance does not matter, apart from small interferences. NR-18 p.1392 NR-18 p.1391Ummo has visited 218 planets without life or with primary life. First contact with a civilisation, by means of starships, took place with the planet IEYIOBAA; the second ended with the death of the crew. D41-16 p.176The letters also mention messages received from very distant planets, with a delay of up to 38,607 years. D41-16 p.176NR-22 specifies that telepathy passes through the WAAM BOUAWEII BIAEII, where transit time is zero: the conversation seems instantaneous to both speakers, but there is a delay in the receiver’s perception, so that causality is respected. The letter adds: “see in it only an explanation consistent with our own theories”. NR-22 p.1412 NR-22 p.1413According to NR-14 (2003), Earthlings suffer from a “global psychological pathology”. The Ummites will not intervene in our genome: the problem would be psychological, not biological. “Psychoviruses”, ideas transmitted from childhood by parents, school and the media, would gradually alter the connections of the brain; money, religion and nationalist pride would be their main drivers. NR-14 p.1380 NR-14 p.1381In the same letter, an expedition member recounts his disappointment at having been assigned to Earth; his wife wanted to appeal to the scientific council to change this assignment. NR-14 p.1379

The example family: a couple aged 34 and almost 31, a boy, a 16-year-old girl who studies biopathology, and the husband’s retired parents, who live under the same roof D41-3 p.91. It is 196 UIW and the whole house is silent. Tonight, the transparent roof panels were closed; the following night, they will be removed and the family will sleep under the open sky D41-3 p.92. On the horizon, a glow between indigo and reddish announces IUMMA; outside, it is about 3 °C D41-3 p.93. No alarm clock: the habit, learned from childhood, is enough D41-3 p.93. Each person puts on a round cape, the GIUDUUDAA EEWE, then makes their foam bed disappear, dissolved by acids: one never sleeps twice in the same bed D41-3 p.93. ≈ 203 UIWtime not specified by the letter · ≈ 8 h 07 on a day scaled to 24 h

Everyone gathers in one room. The father greets each person by placing his hands on his chest, laughs and comments on the night’s incidents, then dictates the day’s instructions D41-3 p.94. He then asks the opinion of his parents, his wife and the children; each listens to the others’ reasoning and decides what he or she will do D41-3 p.94. ≈ 210 UIWtime not specified by the letter · ≈ 8 h 24 on a day scaled to 24 h

Today, it is the wife who prepares the bath. For about 7 UIW, she opens and closes the jets of a nozzle disc while sniffing the mixture: the IAI KEAI, the art of blending essences D41-3 p.94. She records the dosage in a small AARBI OMAIU, a memory in a titanium crystal D41-3 p.94. Then the whole family enters a steam laden with ozone and aromas, behind screens that have risen from the floor; they laugh, they talk, and the blends follow one another “like a symphony of olfactory nuances” D41-3 p.95. 218 UIW≈ 8 h 43 on a day scaled to 24 h

At 218 UIW, the husband leaves the bath: it is his turn to cook D41-4 p.96. Ultrasonic whistles bring the UAMIIXANMOO out of the tiling, an automatic kitchen programmed by a titanium memory D41-4 p.96. No one goes shopping: food arrives through a network of underground tubes driven by helium, in standardised cylinders stored around the tower D41-4 p.97 D41-4 p.98. An INOWII fruit, freed from its gelatine sheath by liquid oxygen, is ready in less than a tenth of a UIW D41-4 p.98 D41-4 p.99. 225 UIW≈ 9 h 00 on a day scaled to 24 h

Around 225 UIW, dawn has just ended: IUMMA stands between indigo and orange mists. This is the longest and most copious meal of the day D41-5 p.100. It begins with a few UIW of silence, eyes closed, recalling pleasant memories D41-5 p.103. Each person sips their broths through a long tube, which “will remind you of HOOKAHS”, say the letters D41-5 p.104. Before the solid foods, the hands are passed through the NAAXUNII, which gloves them in a thin film D41-5 p.104 D41-5 p.105; food is cut with the EIWOO OINNA, an ultraviolet-beam “cutter” D41-5 p.105, then come the slices of AIMMOA D41-5 p.106 and the meat of OOGIXUAA D41-5 p.107. 246 UIW≈ 9 h 50 on a day scaled to 24 h

At 246 UIW, the after-meal conversation is over: the husband must leave, sometimes many KOAE away D41-6 p.109. He puts on a new suit, purple with yellow circles: these colours form a code of occupations D41-6 p.109. He takes leave of his family and boards a GOONIIOADOO UEWA D41-6 p.110. The vehicle glides 0.56 m above the ground, guided by the XANMOO AYUBAA computer network; the probability of an accident is said to be 0.00007 D41-6 p.111. ≈ 285 UIWtime not specified by the letter · ≈ 11 h 24 on a day scaled to 24 h

The working day is short: from 50 to 75 UIW, or between 2.58 and 3.87 hours D41-3 p.92. The husband is an inspector: with a device that sees through the strata of the ground, he checks the terrain near the large underground pipelines and passes any anomaly on to the computer network D41-3 p.91 D41-3 p.92. Beneath the surface flow the raw materials, as foams, as aerosols and even as plasma currents D41-6 p.112. ≈ 380 UIWtime not specified by the letter · ≈ 15 h 12 on a day scaled to 24 h

Once work is finished, each person devotes themselves to the home, the family, their intellectual, religious and technical education, or to play D41-3 p.92. Men and women do sports exercises every day during the play hours D41-4 p.97. Outside, the landscape has been embellished: new forests, artificial rivers, flowers created in the laboratory, and the trees typical of Ummo, NAANAA, IGUU and OAXAUXAA D41-6 p.112 D41-6 p.113. ≈ 525 UIWtime not specified by the letter · ≈ 21 h 00 on a day scaled to 24 h

“Almost always at nightfall”, the house rises from its pit: a piston, pushed by vaporised sodium, lifts it at constant speed D41-2 p.88. The houses rotate on themselves, and the night countryside “seems filled with coastal lighthouses” D41-2 p.86. In the distance, old volcanoes hurl incandescent columns that give Ummo’s nights an impressive appearance D41-6 p.113. 575 UIW≈ 23 h 00 on a day scaled to 24 h

At around 575 UIW, everyone withdraws to rest. The nights are cold D41-9 p.130. The couple stays alone, in a room closed off from noise; the walls glow a soft magenta or violet D41-9 p.130. Perhaps, tonight, the UULIBOOA will unfurl their green bands across the sky, visible through the roof D41-9 p.130: they are far more frequent than terrestrial auroras, even at the equator D41-3 p.93. Seated in their pit-seats, the spouses go over the day’s acts and offer themselves to WOA; this meditation rarely lasts less than 20 UIW D41-9 p.130. 10 UIW≈ 0 h 24 on a day scaled to 24 h

Faint sound signals, at around 10 UIW, “a little after midnight”, may mark the end of the meditation D41-9 p.131. After an ablution in the pit-seat filled with water D41-9 p.131, two rings emerge from the floor and float in levitation; a foam solidifies on them into a couch, the WOIOA D41-2 p.89. The most frequent length of sleep is 175 UIW D41-3 p.92. The nights are “intensely dark”, without the spectacle of a moon as on Earth, but the stars are very sharp there D41-3 p.92 D41-3 p.93. Tomorrow, at 196 UIW, everything will begin again.
